create_pipeline_zero_shot_audio_classifi: create a ZeroShotAudioClassificationPipeline to classify audio with candidate labels using a CLAP model
run_pipeline_classify_audio: run the pipeline to assign labels to audio input from numpy arrays, local files, or HTTP URLs
preprocess_audio_with_labels: preprocess raw audio bytes or numpy arrays with candidate labels and hypothesis template for zero-shot classification
forward_model_audio_text_inputs: forward audio and text inputs through the CLAP model to get logits_per_audio for label scoring
postprocess_logits_to_scores: postprocess model logits with softmax to produce ranked label-score pairs sorted by confidence
